title: Indiana Code Title 22, Article 2, Chapter 9 (Wage Claims)
source_id: IC 22-2-9 (esp. IC 22-2-9-2, discharge of employee; unpaid wages; payment; labor disputes)
verified_how: Same 2026 Title 22 data file: chapter entry number '22-2-9' name 'Chapter 9. Wage Claims', year '2026', public true; sections 22-2-9-1 'Definitions' and 22-2-9-2 'Discharge of employee; unpaid wages; payment; labor disputes' both present.
notes: This is the closest Indiana statute to the topic: it fixes when a separated employee must be paid and routes claims to the Department of Labor. Indiana employment is at will and there is no state severance-pay or mass-layoff notice Act (no state WARN); the federal WARN Act, 29 U.S.C. 2101-2109, supplies plant-closing notice.
